name: Headstand at the Wall
description: Supported Headstand with a wall behind you: with your forearms down and fingers interlaced near the wall, lift your legs up and rest your heels on the wall, the weight mostly in your forearms.

source.title: Yoga Selection: Headstand preparation at the wall
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Forearms down, fingers interlaced, a hand's width or so from the wall.
Crown of the head on the floor, the back of the head against your hands.
cues: Shoulders lift away from your ears.
Heels rest on the wall lightly.

keyframes.name: Dolphin
keyframes.cue: Forearms down, lift the hips high.

keyframes.name: Supported Headstand
keyframes.cue: Interlace the hands behind the head, walk in, and lift the legs.
